name: AI DECISIONS Compliance API
description:
Address risk screening for crypto compliance: sanctions hits, mixer exposure, AI-agent detection and a population-calibrated risk tier per address across Ethereum, Bitcoin, Tron, Base, Arbitrum and Gnosis. Every label resolves to a primary public source.

Authentication: `X-API-Key` header. Keys and tiers: https://aidecisions.ai/pricing. Human-readable docs: https://aidecisions.ai/docs. Try without an account: https://aidecisions.ai/check. Methodology: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7366202.
